work.summary: Make OCR review uncertainty self-explanatory and locally editable without forcing the full editor.
completed: Separated OCR field issues, consistency issues, and machine-link confirmation into distinct badges.
Added exact-field highlighting with an adjacent Edit button for uncertain/missing metadata and item values.
Added inline single-field editors that re-evaluate the review after correction without persisting data.
Renamed the bottom editor action to 全体を編集 and kept the existing full editor available on demand.

coverage: machine-only issue renders as 紐づけ確認 1件 and not OCR確認
uncertain productCode is highlighted at the exact field with an adjacent 編集 button
inline correction updates only the in-memory review value and clears the matching uncertainty warning
editing vendorNumber refreshes machine matching without persisting a link or draft
全体を編集 remains available and mounts the existing detailed editor

nextAction: Deploy FINAL.7 and verify the live version. Real-device OCR reviews should distinguish machine-link confirmation from OCR uncertainty and allow exact-field inline correction.
